predecessors.name: British Cape Colony
predecessors.text: Transorangia between the Orange and Vaal rivers, the Orange River Sovereignty proclaimed by Harry Smith on 3 February 1848; the british-cape-colony dossier (af-07-a) records the matching loss in…

successors.name: Orange River Colony
successors.text: the republic as Cliopatria draws it to 1899

ledger.x: 23 February 1854: Britain gives up the Orange River Sovereignty and the Free State is born.
15 October 1858: a treaty fixes the boundary.
11 April 1866: the peace of Thaba Bosiu.
12 February 1869: the Treaty of Aliwal North ends the wars.
12 February 1869: the Free State receives the Conquered Territory.
11 October 1899: the Free State joins the Boer invasion of Natal.
28 February 1900: Ladysmith is relieved ('Buller's troops marched into Ladysmith on 28 February').
31 May 1902: the Treaty of Vereeniging ends the occupation and the republic.
31 May 1902: the Orange Free State ceases to exist.

wars.name: First Basotho War (Senekal's War)
wars.outcome: Armistice on 1 June 1858 and a treaty of 15 October 1858 defining the new boundary.

wars.name: Second Basotho War (Seqiti War)
wars.outcome: Moshoeshoe accepted the peace of Thaba Bosiu on 11 April 1866; the page does not say what land changed hands.

wars.name: Third Basotho War
wars.outcome: The Free State overran Basotho land in 1867, leaving only Thaba Bosiu; Britain declared a protectorate on 12 March 1868; the Treaty of Aliwal North (12 February 1869) gave the Conquered Territory to the Free State.

wars.name: Second Boer War
wars.outcome: The Free State joined the Transvaal in October 1899; Cronje surrendered at Paardeberg on 27 February 1900, Bloemfontein fell on 13 March, the state was annexed on 28 May 1900 and the burghers fought on until the Treaty of Vereeniging, 31 May 1902.

certainty.note: The Orange and Vaal rivers are the southern and northern lines (the 1854 convention), but the Basutoland frontier (the Warden Line, the treaty of 15 October 1858, the peace of 1866) was disputed and the Cliopatria outline is the modern…
The Treaty of Aliwal North (12 February 1869) defined the Basutoland border and the Keate arbitration (19 February 1870) fixed the Transvaal line; the Orange and Vaal rivers bound the rest.
